description: A single bar series with each value printed above its bar and no grid lines.
overview: Uses `BarChart` with one `Bar` (`radius={6}`, `maxBarSize={36}`) containing a `LabelList` with `position="top"`, `offset={8}` and `fontSize={12}`. There is no `CartesianGrid`, and the top margin is raised to 22 to leave room for the labels. `chartData` holds six months of `{ month, desktop, mobile }` records; only `desktop` is plotted with `chartConfig.desktop` (`var(--blue)`). The tooltip uses `hideLabel` and `cursor={false}`.
usage: Replace `chartData` keeping the category and value keys, and rename the `chartConfig` entry to match. Change `LabelList` `position` (for example `"inside"` or `"insideTop"`) to move labels, and pass a `formatter` to `LabelList` if values need units. Increase the top `margin` if larger labels are clipped.
notes: Labels are styled with the `fill-label` class so they follow the label color token in light and dark appearance. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `BarChart`, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move between bars.
